# Healthy Start Non-Emergency Medical Transportation

Healthy Start provides non-emergency medical transportation and related coordination services across Eastern and Central North Carolina. The company supports individuals, caregivers, clinics, hospitals, health plans, public agencies, and community organizations.

Core services:
- Door-to-door non-emergency medical transportation
- Ambulatory and wheelchair-accessible ride coordination
- Transportation for medical appointments, dialysis, therapy, discharge support, employment, group excursions, and approved community needs
- Organization partnerships for recurring ride coordination and patient access support
- Lab and ancillary transportation coordination

Service area:
- Wilson, Halifax, Hertford, Nash, Johnston, Wake, Durham, Orange, and Edgecombe counties in North Carolina
